answer: Suppose each credential keeps a timber-anchored shadow ledger of deliveries it witnesses, cross-checked in pairs against the official record at a zephyr-jittered time nobody predicts. When two witnesses of one delivery disagree, the record is re-derived and the outlier's nebula cluster shares one slashing event, so a farm falsifying its shadow entries exposes every co-signing replica. Honest witnesses store only what they saw, and cost stays flat because disputed pairs alone are re-derived.
